title: City LOD Scene (City LOD)
prompt:
Use Three.js to build a simplified city scene: a street grid + 50 buildings, with each building using LOD (THREE.LOD) to switch detail levels as distance changes; support day/night and fog adjustments.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
</script>

[Scene]
(1) The ground must consist of planar grid lines, or a light-colored ground surface + dark road stripes, forming a regular street grid.
(2) Exactly 50 buildings: each building must be an LOD node with at least 2–3 detail levels (such as a low-poly Box, a medium-detail model with windows, and a high-detail subdivided or decorated model), switching according to camera distance.
(3) id="dayNightToggle": checkbox; true means daytime (bright background and daylight), while false means nighttime (dark background, emissive windows, or enhanced point lighting).
(4) id="fogSlider": range; controls the Fog near/far values or density, allowing the fog distance to be swept.
(5) Move the camera with OrbitControls to trigger LOD updates.

[State Exposure (Required)]
window.__3D_STATE__ = {
  buildingCount: number,      // Always 50
  lodLevel: number,         // Current "dominant" LOD level index or discrete value 0/1/2 (the implementation must explain its meaning in a comment)
  cameraDistance: number,   // Distance from the camera to the scene center or origin
  fogDistance: number,      // Fog-related scalar (such as far or density), consistent with fogSlider
  isDayTime: boolean,
  visibleBuildings: number    // Estimated number of buildings inside the view frustum or not completely obscured by fog, or 50 if culling is not implemented
}

[Evaluation Helper (Required, for StateProbe)]
(6) window.__STATEPROBE_setCameraDistance__(d: number): position the camera approximately d units from the scene center (using spherical coordinates or a fixed direction), to reliably trigger LOD and update __3D_STATE__.cameraDistance.

Output a single HTML file that can run when opened directly in a browser.
